v1 case description: QA observed BR-204 still in DE

units.description: Validated as-built baseline. DE bearing from affected lot replaced during rework. A slot-scoped missed scan affects NDE only.
units.title: Complete DE replacement, unrelated NDE gap

units.description: No as-built capture exists. First DE record is a removal scanning the affected lot, then an install of an unaffected lot.
units.title: Missing DE baseline

units.description: Validated as-built baseline with DE = BR-204. Rework installs BR-310 into DE with no recorded removal.
units.title: Install into occupied slot

units.description: Station-wide outage while DE was empty. Independent QA verification after install; post-recall damage inspection passed.
units.title: DE outage bounded by independent verification

units.description: Same outage as case-04 with neither slot verification nor damage inspection.
units.title: DE outage, no verification, no inspection

units.description: Same outage as case-04. Damage inspection passed, but it does not identify the installed bearing, so current DE contents stay unverified.
units.title: DE outage, inspection passed, no verification

units.description: Case-01 history (without the NDE exception), excluded at W1. A post-recall correction claims the replacement was BR-207, which is in recall scope.
units.title: Late risk-increasing correction

units.description: As case-05, followed by independent QA verification observing BR-207 in DE.
units.title: Late correction, then corroborated

units.description: Both slots hold lot BR-204. Technician physically replaces NDE but scans the removal and install as DE. Records are internally consistent.
units.title: Wrong-slot scan, lot-level identity (undetected)

units.description: As case-06, plus independent QA verification observing BR-204 still in DE.

syntheticGroundTruth.basis: v1 case description: QA observed BR-204 still in DE

units.title: Wrong-slot scan, caught by verification

units.description: As case-06, plus a valid DE slot-label scan 20 s before the removal scan. The technician scanned the DE label but physically replaced NDE. A label scan shows operator intent, not physical position.
units.title: Wrong-slot scan, valid slot-label scan, no independent verification

units.description: Serial-level identity. The removal claims DE but reads serial SN-204-0002, which the installation record places in NDE. DE therefore still holds SN-204-0001 (lot BR-204).
units.title: Serialized removal conflicts with the recorded slot

units.description: Events identical to case-06c (valid DE label scan, lot-level identity, no verification) but the technician really did replace DE. Same records, opposite physical truth: the cost of not guessing.
units.title: Correct replacement, indistinguishable from case-06c

units.description: As case-06e, plus an independent ACTOR-07 physical check observing BR-310 in DE.
units.title: Valid label scan plus independent QA verification of DE

units.description: DE holds BR-204 and NDE holds BR-310 (different lots). DE replaced with BR-312. A lot-level removal scan can only have come from DE, so nothing is ambiguous and no extra evidence is needed.
units.title: Distinct lots, no attribution ambiguity

units.description: Clean replacement (distinct lots) and an unverified handheld later reports BR-204 in DE. The reading is correct: DE still holds the affected bearing.
units.title: Untrusted observation of an affected lot in DE

units.description: Clean replacement (distinct lots) and an unverified handheld later reports BR-204 in DE. Events identical to case-08 but the reading was a scanner error.
units.title: Same events, handheld misread

units.description: Clean replacement (distinct lots) and an unverified handheld later reports BR-204 in DE. A later independent QA check finds BR-312.
units.title: Untrusted observation answered by a later independent check

units.description: The handheld read BR-204 in DE at 09:00, before the 11:00 replacement.
units.title: Untrusted observation predating the replacement

units.description: The handheld reports BR-204 in NDE (out of scope for this recall policy).
units.title: Untrusted affected-lot observation outside the policy scope

units.description: As case-06c (ambiguous removal). The handheld reports BR-310 in DE.
units.title: Untrusted unaffected-lot observation cannot release

units.description: As case-08g, but the handheld time is operator-entered, so it cannot be placed before the replacement.
units.title: Untrusted observation with an unreliable clock

units.description: As case-08g, but the reading was recorded at 11:30, after the replacement was recorded: occurredAt alone says old, recordedAt does not.
units.title: Untrusted observation that arrives late

units.description: A handheld reading for motor M-999 sits in this history.
units.title: Observation attributed to another motor
